items.title: Any tree
items.text: Folders, budgets, categories: anything with children and a value.

items.title: Hover and click
items.text: The middle names the piece under the pointer; a click or tap selects it.

items.title: VoiceOver
items.text: Every piece is a button with its label and detail.

items.title: Light and dark
items.text: System colors per branch, outer rings fainter, on macOS and iOS.

items.title: Laid out once
items.text: The rings are computed when the tree changes, never on a mouse move.

items.title: No dependencies
items.text: SwiftUI only, Swift 6 with strict concurrency.
